entityDescription:
Design Terminal is Central Europe’s leading innovation agency, which builds ‘Innovation Champions’ through corporate partnerships and talent acceleration. We believe entrepreneurial culture is based on optimism, which drives meaningful innovation. We give corporate leaders and startup founders the knowledge and access they need to catalyze innovation across any organization. Incubation programs are up and running in twelve countries, and since 2014 the organization has worked with more than 1000 startups and several leading corporations. 

The mission of Design Terminal is mentoring business talent, developing the Central European entrepreneurial ecosystem and adopting global best practices related to innovation. Apart from talents in Hungary and the Carpathian Basin, in 2017 our Mentoring program opened its gates to startups from any part of the world – and many did apply, from altogether 12 countries ranging from Chile through the UK all the way to India. The goal of our global expansion was to prove that Central Europe can be a winner in the race for talent and innovative workforce. We are building a value proposition comparable with any similar initiative in Western Europe, and which can attract startups to Budapest from even remote countries of the world. Participants of the Design Terminal Mentoring Program acquire new skills not only from their mentors, but also from each other, and by sharing their network they can contribute to each other’s success as well.

entityDescription:
Exatel is a Poland's leader of ICT security services. For over 20 years, in every place in Poland, we have been providing comprehensive telecommunication services to operators, business entities and public sector institutions. We are Poland’s leader of ICT security services. As a wholesale voice operator, we successfully perform our activities in the global market. Hundreds of operators, both in Poland and abroad, have trusted us. We rely on a modern and extensive transmission network. This is why we are the bridge that connects the east and the west of Europe. EXATEL is one of main Polish telecom carriers and is offering services for business customers. We are heavily investing in upgrading of our optical access network in order to deliver front-haul and back-haul services for Polish mobile operators. The main goal is to be ready for 5G network deployment and to effectively reuse of already deployed legacy equipment in future. After many years of cooperation with telecom equipment vendors and business customers we have gained practical knowledge and experience on developing and setting up the state of the art optical systems and services. We have encountered and successfully solved various problems regarding multi-vendor and multi-technology network operation and maintenance. We are looking for new technologies and cost effective optical components to be introduced in our network in order to improve flexibility, optimize CAPEX and OPEX, reduce service delivery time, provide greater bandwidth and better performance - higher optical power budget. Exatel manage a modern data transmission network of nearly 20,000 km.
This is the second biggest infrastructure in Poland’s telecommunication market. We are able to deliver each and every service connected with domestic telecommunication – from backbone networks to access lines. We have direct connections with over 100 foreign operators and contact points with partners in all the neighbouring countries. This is why we are an important bridge in the traffic transit between the East and the West of Europe.

description:
Sirin Orbital Systems AG (sirin-os.com) is a Swiss innovative SME based in Zürich, Switzerland, focusing on the development and commercialization of advanced technologies for the needs of the emerging space market. The company founders have more than twelve years of professional R&D experiences in the field of space-technologies. These competences comprise advanced enabling technologies for on-orbit servicing of satellites, high-performance intelligent space cameras for space debris mitigation in active debris removal missions, on-board optical instrumentation for earth observation, nanosatellites telecommunication system, micro-propulsion systems for small satellites and wireless power transmission systems for planetary exploration and solar power satellites. Sirin-OS is knowledgeable in space project management, satellite subsystem design and system engineering. In addition, miniaturization of advanced technologies for compact instrumentation on-board small satellites and planetary exploration probes was in the scope of past projects. Thus, the company is proficient in leading R&D projects on new space-born instruments in the interest of scientific programs and the commercial space market. 

WE CREATE VIABLE INNOVATIVE PRODUCTS, SERVICES AND SOLUTIONS FOR UPSTREAM AND DOWNSTREAM APPLICATIONS BASED ON CUTTING EDGE TERRESTRIAL TECHNOLOGIES AND SPACE ASSETS.
entityDescription:
Sirin Orbital Systems AG "SIRIN" creates viable innovative products, services and solutions for upstream and downstream applications based on cutting-edge technologies and space assets. 

SIRIN is an innovative Swiss space-tech company founded in 2019 in Zürich, Switzerland, specialized in the development of advanced technologies for diverse needs of the emerging space market and future sustainable space exploration. SIRIN's actual core products include: (i) a game-changing green, safe, scalable and high-performance chemical micro-propulsion system for small-satellites, (ii) an air-breathing propulsion concept for very low-altitude missions, (iii) wireless power transfer (WPT) enabling technologies, and (iv) a high-performance intelligent space camera for active debris removal (ADR) and proximity missions. Further R&D areas include innovative technologies for on-orbit servicing (OOS) of satellites, in-orbit refilling and fuel storage systems, lunar and planetary life support systems and power generators, and quantum-based systems for space applications. The company also provides AI-based solutions for the use of space technologies and EO satellite services for ground-based applications.

Laboratories and certifications
Product quality controls and certifications issued with compliance on technical requirements and standards, in accordance with international regulations.
R&D
Privately contracted projects with clients for the development of specific products and/or improvement of production processes, in addition to various R&D consultancy services. The results remain exclusively the property of the client.
Technical training
Technical training of professionals in new techniques, technologies, knowledge, and textile processes. University Master's Degrees are taught in collaboration with Universities.

In the case of the aerospace field, the integration of advanced textile technologies can provide different elements of space suits (e.g., EVA suits, indoor suits…), aircrafts, spacecrafts, etc., with enhanced capabilities, which enable improved security and performance of both, astronauts, and spacecrafts.

description: ECHOES s.r.l. is an Italian engineering company specialized in the design, development and manufacturing of innovative radar systems and sub-systems (both hardware and software).
entityDescription:
ECHOES s.r.l. is an Italian engineering company specialized in the design, development and manufacturing of innovative radar systems and sub-systems (both hardware and software).

ECHOES offers customer-oriented full-stack radar solutions, from the design up to small-series production for a wide range of civil and military applications from HF up to K bands.
ECHOES is mainly focused on imaging radar market segment, in particular towards:
- structural, geotechnical and environmental monitoring,
- aerospace & defence,
- security and surveillance.

ECHOES has a strong experience in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Inverse SAR systems with imaging, interferometric and change detection capabilities for deformation monitoring, mapping and surveillance applications from both terrestrial and aerial platforms (UAVs and aircrafts). ECHOES offers light-weight, affordable and reliable radar systems with the best user experience guaranteeing an extremely ease of transportability, installation and use also in harsh environments with real-time and on-board processing.
Our lean structure, high level of know-how and innovative radar technologies are our main competitive advantages. 
Our expertise is mainly in radar imaging (SAR, ISAR), beamforming, multichannel and MIMO architectures, advanced radar signal processing techniques with real-time capabilities.

description:
Conspection Ltd. is a Zagreb-based company providing services in the fields of research, development, and innovation. Our target customers are private or public companies conducting research in the fields of high technology and applied science. Our Mission is to provide the necessary infrastructure to support the development of business lines within the fields of high technology and applied science. In order to achieve that mission, Conspection Ltd. is working closely together with a strong international network of industrial and academic partners, and benefits from the expertise of renowned technical advisors.
We have expertise is in the field of small solar system bodies, NEOs, space debris, astronomical instrumentation R&D and commissioning, as well as in providing astronomical observations in VIS and NIR (imaging, spectroscopy, polarimetry, spectropolarimetry), operating sky-surveys (former La Sagra Sky Survey co-founder and member) data reduction (development of reduction pipelines) and data interpretation (scientific methods).

entityDescription: Infocom s.r.l. (INFO) is an SME, founded in 1999, which provides consultancy services in the ICT area. INFO’s main customers consist of telco device manufacturers, which INFO supports in the development of network devices’ embedded software as well as of OSS/BSS functionality, and of vertical industries (mainly active in the transportation field), which INFO provides with custom ICT solutions that fit strict security and reliability constraints imposed by critical services. INFO is strongly committed to research and innovation, as proven by its involvement in various local, national and international research projects, including EU funded projects in the scope of FP7 and H2020 programs. INFO is part of the European Digital SME alliance. INFO's key areas of expertise include SW design, development and validation, design of mobile/fixed solutions for the deployment of telecommunication services, technologies for virtualized networking and computing (e.g. OSM, Kubernetes, OpenStack, LibVirt, QEMU, OpenFlow)
